task.description:
Implement the shared pagination module per the design at src/design/api-06-pagination.md.

Implementation tasks:

1. Create src/api/pagination.zig with:
   - Cursor struct (decode, prefix validation, expiry check)
   - PageResponse(T) generic struct
   - validatePageSize(n) function (1-200, default 50)
   - encodeCursor / decodeCursor (base64url, prefix validation, 24h expiry → 410)
   - buildRawCursor helpers
   - Utility functions (findNthColon, parseIntFromCursor)

2. Refactor existing endpoints to use the shared module:
   - tasks.zig: replace inline cursor decode/encode with pagination.zig calls (preserve "T:" prefix)
   - instances.zig handleList: add "I:" prefix cursor via pagination.zig
   - instances.zig handleHistory: replace inline cursor code with pagination.zig (preserve "H:" prefix)
   - definitions.zig: add "D:" prefix cursor + 24h expiry via pagination.zig

3. Remove duplicated helpers after refactoring (e.g., inline base64url functions in handlers)

4. Update main.zig or build.zig if needed for the new module import

Security constraints:
- NO SQL string interpolation - use $N placeholders
- All allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator
- NO I/O in src/engine/transition.zig

Acceptance criteria:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- All existing tests pass (no regressions)
- src/api/pagination.zig exists with all public functions
- All 4 endpoints use shared pagination module
acceptance_criteria: src/api/pagination.zig exists with Cursor, PageResponse, validatePageSize, encodeCursor, decodeCursor
tasks.zig refactored to use shared pagination
instances.zig handleList refactored with I: prefix cursor
instances.zig handleHistory refactored to use shared pagination
definitions.zig refactored with D: prefix cursor and expiry

result.summary: Implemented API-06 shared pagination module (src/api/pagination.zig) with Cursor struct, PageResponse(T), validatePageSize, encodeCursor, decodeCursor, buildRawCursor, buildRawCursorTimestampKey, parseIntFromCursor, findNthColon, and 24h cursor expiry. Refactored all 4 endpoints: tasks.zig (T: prefix), instances.zig handleList (I: prefix, three-segment cursor with manual expiry), instances.zig handleHistory (H: prefix, format-before-expiry validation), definitions.zig (D: prefix, 24h expiry). Removed duplicated base64url encode/decode helpers from tasks.zig and instances.zig; replaced definitions.zig inline encodeCursor/decodeCursor with pagination.zig calls. Updated api03_handler_test.zig cursor format tests to use new I: prefix. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
result.next_action: Route to FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b) for web/src/hooks/usePagination.ts alignment
